title: Spot Dance – Operation Spotlight
description:
•	Songs: Songs are played on the spot at the competition venue. Songs cannot be decided in advance. In some fests, a fusion of 2 or 3 songs will be given.
•	Preparation Time: The participant will get only a very short time (usually 1 to 2 minutes) to listen to and understand the song before dancing to it.
•	Time Limit: Total performance time is usually 2 to 3 minutes.
•	Props: Stage props or special sets are not allowed.
•	Vulgarity: If any vulgar steps or indecent behavior is shown, the participant will be immediately disqualified.
•	ID card: Participants must compulsorily carry their ID Card.

title: Esports Festival – Digital Combat
description:
All participants are requested to follow the rules and regulations mentioned below to ensure fair play, sportsmanship, and a smooth gaming experience.
1. Mini Militia
Use of shields is strictly prohibited.
All participants must follow fair-play rules.
2. PES (eFootball)
Smart Assist must be turned OFF.
Each match will be played for 8 minutes.
If the match ends in a tie, the Golden Goal Rule will apply. The first player to score wins the match.
3. Free Fire
Headshots Only: Players must use headshots only.
All guns are allowed.
4. PUBG Mobile
The FPS limit is set to 60 FPS.
Aim Assist must be turned OFF.
5. General Rules (For All Games) : All participants must use their own mobile data (internet connection).
Participants must follow the rules and regulations of each game.
Any unfair practices or rule violations may lead to disqualification.
The organizers’ decisions will be final.
🏆 PLAY FAIR. PLAY HARD. WIN BIG!
Best wishes to all participants. Let the games begin!

title: Quiz – Intelligence Test
description:
1. Each team must consist of 2 participants.
2. Participants must report to the venue 15 minutes before the quiz begins.
3. The quiz will consist of multiple rounds.
4. Questions will cover Computer Science, IT, programming, technology, and general computer knowledge.
5. Teams must answer only when instructed by the quizmaster.
6. No mobile phones, internet access, or external assistance are allowed.
7. The quizmaster’s decision will be final.
8. Points will be awarded for correct answers.
9. In case of a tie, a tie-breaker round will be conducted.
10. Any form of unfair practice may lead to disqualification.

Quiz Rounds

- Round 1: General Computer Knowledge
- Round 2: Programming and Coding
- Round 3: Identify the Logo / Image
- Round 4: Rapid Fire
- Round 5: Technical Challenge

title: Photography – Case 002
description:
• Participants must capture photographs during the festival within the specified competition period, submission after the specified time will be disqualified 
• Each participant may submit a maximum of 1 photographs.
• Photographs subject will be announced only after the registration.
• Photos must be original and captured by the participant during the event.
• Previously captured photographs are strictly prohibited.
• Basic editing such as cropping, exposure, brightness, contrast, color correction, and white balance is permitted.
• ⁠ Heavy manipulation, Al-generated images, composites, or adding/removing major objects is not permitted.
• Copyrighted photographs taken by someone else may not be submitted.
• Photographs containing inappropriate, offensive, discriminatory, or disrespectful content will be disqualified.

title: Videography – Case 001
description:
• Videos must be recorded during the fest within the specified competition period.
• Each participant may submit one final video.
• Maximum video duration: 3 minutes.
• The video must primarily contain footage captured by the participant during the fest.
• Previously recorded footage may not be used.
• Editing, transitions, color grading, sound design, subtitles, and background music are permitted.
• Al-generated video or footage taken from the internet is not permitted.
• The final video must be submitted in the format and resolution specified by the organizing committee.

title: Web Designing Using AI – Nexora
description:
•	Participation may be individual or in teams of up to two members, as decided by the organisers.
•	All participants must complete registration before the competition begins.
•	Participants must report to the venue at the time announced by the organisers.
•	The decisions of the judges and organising committee will be final.
•	HTML and CSS must be used. JavaScript may be used if permitted by the organisers.
•	Pre-designed templates, copied projects and another participant’s source code are not permitted.
•	Participants must create their own original design and write their own code.
•	The website should open and function in a standard web browser.
•	Suggested duration: 1 hours. The final time limit will be announced by the organisers.
•	Late submissions may not be accepted.

title: Treasure Hunt – Mission Unknown
description:
•	Every participant must carry a valid college ID card. 
•	Each team can have up to 4 members. 
•	A maximum of 30 teams can register for the competition. 
•	The competition will have preliminary rounds. 
•	The rules of each preliminary round will be disclosed only before the start of each round. 
•	Use of mobile phones and electronic devices are strictly prohibited unless specified. 
•	You will get first Clue at the starting point.
•	Solve the clue to find the next location.
•	Time Limit: 1 Hour 
•	Do not damage college property.
•	Do not hide or remove clue papers.
•	Do not enter Staff Room, Office, Lab, Library and classrooms.
•	Do not run, walk safely.
•	Do not follow or copy other teams.
•	The decisions of the organizing committee are final and binding.
•	Violation of any rule will result in disqualification.
•	No team from K E College will be allowed to participate in treasure hunt.

title: Fashion Show – Project Runway
description:
•	Individual participation.
•	Theme Based.
•	Dress must be decent and suitable for a college event. No vulgar, transparent, or offensive outfits.
•	No outfits that hurt religious or cultural sentiments.
•	Costumes must be arranged by participants themselves. College will not provide costumes.
•	Late entry will be disqualified.
•	Music must be submitted before 15 minutes of the event in pen drive / phone in mp3 format. No last-minute change.
•	Songs must be decent. 
•	No fire, water, smoke, glass, sharp objects, or dangerous stunts on stage.
•	No throwing of objects towards audience / judges.

title: Penalty Shootout
description:
•	The competition will be conducted in a Knockout Format.
•	Winning teams will advance to the next round.
•	Each team will be given 5 penalty shots.
•	If both teams score an equal number of goals, a sudden-death round will be conducted.
•	The decision of the referee and organizing committee will be final and binding.

title: Reel Making – Reel Mistry
description:
•	Participants must capture the videos and photos during the event.
•	The reel must showcase the major highlights of the event.
•	The final duration should not cross 90 seconds .
•	The video must be in vertical format.
•	Participants can use mobile phones and cameras.
•	Only footage and photographs related to the event are permitted.
•	All sorts of non-offensive background music, editing methods are allowed.
•	The final out should be submitted on or before 4 pm.
•	Judge’s decisions will be final.
